name: Cherry Cookies Cartridge | 1g
description: Cherry Cookies serves up warm, bakery vibes with a soft cherry kick and a laid-back body feel. It’s the kind of vape that wraps around you — mellow, flavorful, and just sweet enough to keep you coming back.
